title: 0265 Computer Science Component 2 – Sample Practice Paper

parts.label: 11(a)
parts.context_html:
A database table PLANET contains data about some planets.

planet_namedistance_auradius_kmnumber_moonsstructure
Earth163781rocky
Jupiter5.26991195gas
Mars1.533902rocky
Mercury0.424400rocky
Neptune302476416ice
Saturn9.560250146gas
Uranus192555928ice
Venus0.7260520rocky

A second table in the database contains the table NEWS that contains information about news stories related to space.

titleplanet_nameyear
The Curiosity landedMars2011
Voyager 1 about to leave the solar system2012
A clearer picture of Pluto2015
15 years of OpportunityMars2019
A Dragon leaves for ISSEarth2012
parts.question_html: (a) State the primary key of the PLANET table.

parts.label: 11(b)
parts.question_html: (b) Identify two records from the NEWS table that do not have a foreign key value. State the titles of these records.

parts.label: 11(c)
parts.question_html: (c) State the field used as a foreign key to link the NEWS table to the PLANET table.

parts.label: 11(d)
parts.question_html:
(d) Use the PLANET table to show the output given by the SQL statement:

SELECT planet_name, distance_au

WHERE structure = "gas" OR num_moons < 1

ORDER BY distance_au ASC;

parts.label: 14(a)
parts.context_html:
A hotel has 30 rooms of different types: single, double, twin and family. The list room_type contains the type of room. The list room_occupied contains the word 'booked' or the word 'available' depending on its status. The same index position in both lists refers to the same room.

The lists are already filled and initialised with data.
parts.question_html: (a) Write a program to output the number of rooms available.

parts.label: 14(b)
parts.context_html:
A hotel has 30 rooms of different types: single, double, twin and family. The list room_type contains the type of room. The list room_occupied contains the word 'booked' or the word 'available' depending on its status. The same index position in both lists refers to the same room.

The lists are already filled and initialised with data.

(b) A room can be booked up to a maximum of 14 nights. The cost of each type of room is shown in the table.

type of roomcost in dollars for one night
double60
family90
single40
twin50
parts.question_html:
Write a program that:

  • takes an input of number of nights and stores it in an appropriate variable
  • validates the input
  • takes an input of type of room
  • calculates the total cost of the room
  • outputs the total cost, type of room and number of nights.

Inputs and outputs must contain suitable messages.

parts.label: 14(c)
parts.context_html:
A hotel has 30 rooms of different types: single, double, twin and family. The list room_type contains the type of room. The list room_occupied contains the word 'booked' or the word 'available' depending on its status. The same index position in both lists refers to the same room.

The lists are already filled and initialised with data.
parts.question_html:
(c) Employees of the hotel receive a discount of 20% when booking a room at the hotel.

Write the function discount to:

  • take the cost of the booking as a parameter
  • return the cost with the discount applied
  • add a suitable comment to explain the purpose of the function.

parts.label: 14(d)
parts.context_html:
A hotel has 30 rooms of different types: single, double, twin and family. The list room_type contains the type of room. The list room_occupied contains the word 'booked' or the word 'available' depending on its status. The same index position in both lists refers to the same room.

The lists are already filled and initialised with data.
parts.question_html:
(d) Write a program that:

  • takes an input of room type
  • searches for an available room of that type
  • outputs 'room available' and the room number if there is a room of that type available
  • outputs 'no rooms available of that type' and asks the user if they want to search again
  • repeats the program if the user wants to search again.
